children: The benchmark indices witnessed mixed performance for another session on September 18, with the Nifty 50 rising 0.33 percent, while the BSE Sensex declined 0.03 percent. Market breadth remained positive, with about 2,151 shares advancing against 1,094 declining shares on the NSE. The market could remain in consolidation as long as it trades within the previous week's range. Here are some short-term trading ideas to consider.
Hitesh Rathi, Technical Analyst (Equity & Derivatives) at Angel One

Following a price breakout on the candlestick charts across all timeframes, accompanied by very high volumes, Tilaknagar Industries has since undergone a retest of its breakout zone. The retracement has occurred on very low volumes, pointing towards an absence of significant supply and indicating that the breakout remains technically healthy.

On the Point & Figure charts as well, the stock has invalidated a prior bearish setup comprising a Weak Breakout and a Bearish Anchor Column, indicating a clear shift in control from sellers towards buyers. Hence, the buying in Tilaknagar Industries is recommended at around Rs 565-560.

A sharp bounce back following the retest of the recent breakout in UNO Minda, where the stock also retested its 200 DSMA, indicates the presence of strong buying interest at lower levels and suggests that buyers continue to remain in control.

The formation of a Bullish 100% Pole on the Point & Figure charts, right from its 10-column moving average, provides further confirmation of the underlying strength in the stock. Adding to the positive setup, the formation of a Bullish Swing Engulfing pattern on the 1% Renko charts, where the stock also retested its 40-brick Moving Average, further indicates that the stock could march higher in the coming days. Hence, the buying is recommended in the stock around Rs 1,285-1,280.

After taking support at an upward-sloping trendline, which has cushioned prices on multiple occasions, Physicswallah has now triggered a bullish price breakout on its candlestick charts. A follow-through Double Top Breakout on the 1% Point & Figure charts, following the formation of a Bullish-Bearish Pattern Reversal, provides further confirmation of the resumption of its uptrend.

A follow-through Swing Breakout on the 1% Renko charts provides additional confirmation that buyers continue to remain in control of the stock, suggesting that higher prices could be witnessed in the coming sessions. Hence, the buying is recommended in the stock around Rs 136-135.
Jatin Gedia, VP - Technical Research at Teji Mandi Investment Technologies

ASK Automotive has been in an uptrend. Since the past five weeks, the stock has been undergoing an intermediate degree pullback. It has retraced towards the 38.2% retracement level (Rs 592) and the 40 day exponential moving average (Rs 601). It has witnessed buying interest from the support cluster Rs 590 – 600 and in terms of price pattern it has broken out of a bullish flag pattern suggesting resumption of the next leg of the up move.

The breakout has been accompanied with above average volume suggesting a genuine breakout. Trend indicator has triggered a fresh positive crossover from below the equilibrium line suggesting start of a new cycle. Thus considering the price pattern breakout and the momentum setup we expect the stock to continue with the positive momentum during the week.

Alembic Pharma has started to form higher highs and higher lows on the weekly charts indicating an uptrend. Since the past couple of months the stock has been consolidating between Rs 800 and Rs 840. In the previous trading session, it has given a price volume breakout above that range suggesting start of a next leg of up move.

The Bollinger bands have started to expand after a contraction and prices are tagging the upper Bollinger band suggesting start off a strong and directional uptrend. The stock recorded the highest volume of the previous 10 trading weeks suggesting strong buying interest.

The daily momentum indicator has a positive crossover which is a buy signal. Thus considering the price volume breakout and the momentum set up we expect these top to trade with a positive bias over the next few trading sessions.

Bajaj Housing Finance has been consolidating since the last five months. It has formed multiple bottoms at Rs 82 - 83 zone. In the previous session, it broke out from an ending diagonal pattern accompanied with above average volume. The momentum indicator has regard a fresh bullish crossover after sporting a Positive divergence Indicating exhaustion of selling pressure.

We expect the stock to test the 200-day exponential moving average which is currently placed at Rs 91 with the potential to rise towards Rs 93 coinciding with the previous swing highs. Thus considering the price pattern breakout and the momentum setup we expect the stock to trade with the positive bias.

title: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade UNO Minda, Tilaknagar Industries, ASK Automotive, Alembic Pharma, Bajaj Housing, and others on September 21?
